findings.finding: The original continuous-tone image is fully replaced at zoom .15 by 48-colour traced regions. The regions encode pigment, not semantic organs.
Same-colour region outlines expand over neighbouring colour boundaries.
Source contour simplification error is magnified; midpoint quadratic smoothing further changes corners.
Repeated procedural marks sit over the simplified colour fields. They add local texture but cannot restore missing original organ shading or semantic boundaries.
At fixed high zoom only a tissue crop fits in the viewport. A complete-organ overview is a separate view.

visualAssessment: Inspected baseline frames show broad flat-colour patches and repeated marks with weak anatomical identity. This is a rendering-quality finding, separate from whether animation frames advance.
sequenceDelivery: render_body_closeups.py emits lossless PNG frames at explicit absolute visual times and per-view JSON for browser Canvas playback; no autoplay dependency.
limitations: No native GPU screenshot evidence was collected by this subagent.
Static baseline frames do not demonstrate visible animation.
Cairo edge filtering differs from NanoVG.
nextComparison: After runtime freeze, render the same organ/anchor/zoom/time combinations to a different closeup directory; retain this baseline.
